messages:
Alex Chen: Cutting RC candidate in 5m — v2.8.3-rc1. Need smoke evals + failfast toggle check. Can QA hold on verification?
Priya Nair: On it. I'll kick off smoke suite and sanity prompts against canary infra.
deploy-bot: RC build created: 2.8.3-rc1 (sha: f0e1d2c3). Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/2.8.3-rc1. Canary pool: gpu-x1.
Jamie Ortiz: @Priya when you run smoke, please include slow-path chat tests and kv-warm scenarios.
Priya Nair: running smoke now -> /scripts/smoke-run --rc 2.8.3-rc1 --profiles quick,kv-warm
Priya Nair: smoke results: 12/13 tests passed, 1 failure on streaming latency (>2000ms) in us-west-2. attaching snippet:
```
ERR: stream_timeout at model_inference.cpp:412
median_latency: 2350ms
```
Ben Liao: that's the streaming path we saw regress after kernel tweak. Is failfast still enabled?
Marta Gomez: current failfast flag: enabled for hosted tier; disabled for dedicated. Should we flip it off for this RC to avoid auto-rollback?
Alex Chen: I'd prefer disable failfast temporarily so we can gather traces, but we need explicit rollback criteria if we promote.
Jamie Ortiz: Agree. Toggle off in prod policy, keep alerting on severity=high. I'll set a canary rollforward threshold at 1.5x latency baseline.
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: failfast = false for rc-2.8.3-canary on hosted. (by Jamie Ortiz)
Priya Nair: re-ran smoke with failfast off -> now 13/13 pass but two degraded p95s still near threshold. logs: link: https://logs.redwood/rc/2.8.3-rc1
Ben Liao: OK to request pin and promo window? We should pin artifact and add rollback playbook to release notes.
Alex Chen: Pin request: please pin 2.8.3-rc1 to promo window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Also add rollback: revert to 2.8.2 via pin and scale down canary.
Marta Gomez: noted. I'll prepare the rollback runbook and add the quick commands.
Marta Gomez: rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to stable
redwoodctl pin set service/api 2.8.2
redwoodctl rollout set service/api canary=0
```
Jamie Ortiz: QA signoff? @Priya
Priya Nair: +1 QA on smoke and sample prompts. Recommend promo with monitoring hold for first 15m.
Alex Chen: promoted to ops: go/no-go in 10. If no emergencies, /promote at 22:55 UTC.
deploy-bot: Promo scheduled by Alex Chen for 2025-04-03T22:55:00Z. To execute: /promote 2.8.3-rc1 --pin --window 2025-04-03T23:00:00Z/2025-04-04T01:00:00Z
Ben Liao: adding release note blurb: "Address latency regression on streaming path; canary rollout with failfast disabled; rollback ready."
Alex Chen: thanks team. I'll be oncall during promo. ping me immediately if p95 > 2s or error rate > 2%
Priya Nair: will monitor errors and perf dashboards.
Jamie Ortiz: I'll have the auto-fallback rule ready if latency crosses threshold.
Marta Gomez: Rollback playbook copied to release notes and support runbook.
Alex Chen: locking this thread — pin request submitted. :lock:
